surface_metrics.sampling: stratified by triangle area, uniform barycentric draw; deterministic PCG64 seed
surface_metrics.distance_query: continuous triangles; BVH exhausts every node within nearest-distance bound

proxy_union.boundary_method: convex-face polygon subtraction by all other convex halfspaces; float64

source_to_proxy_union.signed_distance_convention: negative inside proxy union, positive outside; zero within exposed-boundary tolerance band

surface_metrics.global_hausdorff_distance: UNKNOWN; maxima are observed finite-query lower bounds
surface_metrics.interpretation: Negative source-to-proxy distance marks source surface buried by proxy (including possible groove/gap capping); positive marks uncovered source. Reverse unsigned deviation alone does not classify outside-source volume.

limits: Float64 halfspace clipping uses the unchanged existing numerical tolerance, not a physical acceptance threshold.
Coverage is source triangle surface inclusion, not source-solid equivalence or a global Hausdorff bound.
continuous_source_triangle_coverage.coverage_change_method: continuous (source triangle outside repaired union) intersected with frozen old convex hull; numerical tolerance only

limits: Original source STL is treated as a surface; its orientation/solid interior is not assumed.
Acute angles ignore source normal winding; oriented angles are included without acceptance claims.
Nearest faces at edges, corners and ties are nonsmooth and can have large angles.
These deterministic finite samples do not certify a global normal-angle maximum.

old_left_derived_proxy.reference: frozen old left-derived finger13 convex hull
old_left_derived_proxy.method: all vertices of each actual part convex hull against every reference convex halfspace
limits: Positive plane violations witness noncontainment; negative violations are plane margins, not distances to the reference boundary.
Source convex-hull containment does not establish source-solid inclusion or absence of groove/cavity capping.
